tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij zdania (1.1.-1.6.), wykorzystujac podane w nawiasach wyrazy w odpowiedniej formie. Nie zmieniaj kolejnosci podanych wyrazow, ale w razie potrzeby dodaj inne wyrazy, tak aby otrzymac logiczne i gramatycznie poprawne zdania. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna.

items.context: You _________ (not / tell) him the secret - now everyone knows. You _________ (keep) it to yourself.
She is not answering. She _________ (be) in a meeting, or she _________ (leave) her phone at home.
answer: may have left / might have left

items.context: We _________ (not / book) a table after all - the restaurant was half empty. It _________ (be) a waste of time.
At my old school we _________ (have) to wear a uniform, and we _________ (not / allow) to wear trainers.
You _________ (not / worry) about the exam - you _________ (study) very hard for weeks.
answer: do not (don't) have to worry / need not (needn't) worry

items.context: He _________ (not / steal) it - he was with me all evening. Somebody else _________ (do) it.
